stories.title: Trump contro Zelensky: "L'Ucraina vada al voto, Putin vuole l'intesa". Strage Zaporizhzhia: 20 morti

en.title: Trump against Zelensky: "Ukraine should vote, Putin wants agreement". Zaporizhzhia massacre: 20 dead
en.summary: Trump pressures Ukraine toward elections while suggesting Putin seeks a deal. Ukrainian officials questioned announcements about diesel supplies, and Russian sources indicate potential envoy visits to Moscow within 15 days.

stories.title: Trump: 'L'attacco all'aeroporto di Riad non è accettabile'

en.title: Trump: 'Attack on Riyadh airport is not acceptable'
en.summary: Trump condemned an attack on Riyadh airport while indicating he maintains communications with the Houthis regarding the incident.

stories.title: Houthi colpiscono di nuovo l’aeroporto di Riad: almeno 12 morti. Raid anche a Sanaa

en.title: Houthis strike Riyadh airport again: at least 12 dead. Raids also in Sanaa
en.summary: The Houthis launched another attack on Riyadh airport resulting in casualties, while Iranian and Russian leaders held talks and regional violence continued across multiple fronts.

stories.title: "Iconico e storico": da Mosca elogi a Trump dopo l'attacco su Zelensky

en.title: "Iconic and historic": Moscow praises Trump after attack on Zelensky
en.summary: Moscow responded positively to Trump's criticism of Zelensky, with Russian negotiators characterizing the White House position as a historic shift.

stories.title: Raid Houthi sull'aeroporto di Riad: terminal colpito

en.title: Houthi raid on Riyadh airport: terminal hit
en.summary: Houthi forces attacked Riyadh airport, causing flight disruptions and prompting concern from Western governments. Trump is considering military intervention alongside Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Autorità, almeno 309 i feriti nell'attacco degli Houthi all'aeroporto di Riad

en.title: Authorities: At least 309 injured in Houthi attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: Civil aviation authorities report that a Houthi attack on Riyadh airport resulted in at least 309 people injured.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia, le news di oggi. Trump: “L'Ucraina dovrebbe andare al voto, Putin mi ha detto che vuole un accordo”

en.title: Ukraine-Russia war, today's news. Trump: "Ukraine should hold elections, Putin told me he wants a deal"
en.summary: Trump renewed criticism of Zelensky and suggested Ukraine needs different leadership. Trump stated Putin expressed interest in reaching an agreement regarding the conflict.

stories.title: Nyt, 'almeno 12 morti nell'attacco degli houthi all'aeroporto di Riad'

en.title: NYT: At least 12 dead in Houthi attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: The New York Times reports that a Houthi attack on Riyadh airport killed at least 12 people, with at least 50 others wounded.

stories.title: Raid Houthi sull’Arabia Saudita, strage all’aeroporto di Riad: 12 morti

en.title: Houthi raid on Saudi Arabia, massacre at Riyadh airport: 12 dead
en.summary: Yemeni rebel forces launched an attack on King Khalid airport in Riyadh, resulting in casualties and injuries. Over 300 people were wounded in the incident.

stories.title: 'Almeno due morti in attacco Houthi su scalo Riad, anche un'assistente di volo'

en.title: At least two dead in Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, including flight attendant
en.summary: Sources report that a Houthi attack on Riyadh airport killed at least two people, including a flight attendant.

stories.title: Riad, missile Houthi sull’aeroporto: 12 morti e 300 feriti. Trump: “Potremmo unirci ai raid sauditi”

en.title: Riyadh, Houthi missile on airport: 12 dead and 300 wounded. Trump: "We could join Saudi raids"
en.summary: A Houthi missile struck Riyadh airport, killing 12 people and injuring around 300 others, forcing airport closure. Trump indicated potential U.S. participation in Saudi military operations.

stories.title: Dmitriev, 'Trump vuole una leadership di pace in Ucraina, è iconico e storico'

en.title: Dmitriev: 'Trump wants peace leadership in Ukraine, it is iconic and historic'
en.summary: Dmitriev states that Trump seeks to exercise leadership toward peace in Ukraine, describing this position as iconic and historic. He references diesel diplomacy as having exposed Zelensky.

stories.title: Ex Ilva: «Stop per l’ordine dei giudici e perché siamo senza materie prime»

en.title: Ex Ilva: "Stoppage due to court order and lack of raw materials"
en.summary: The company cited unrealistic conditions imposed by magistrates within 90 days and stated it halted purchasing for production due to anticipated plant closure.

stories.title: Tatuaggi e piercing, imprese più che raddoppiate in 10 anni

en.title: Tattoos and piercings, businesses more than doubled in 10 years
en.summary: Tattoo and piercing businesses in Italy increased by 160 percent between 2017 and 2026, with Rome leading in absolute numbers and Bari showing the fastest growth rate.

stories.title: L’export resiste alla crisi energetica. Diversificare chiave per la crescita

en.title: Exports resist energy crisis. Diversification key for growth
en.summary: A Promos Italia white paper examines Italian export trends between 2021 and 2026, analyzing how exports have performed through economic and geopolitical challenges.

stories.title: Parte a Torino il progetto per il “super caccia”. In arrivo duemila posti

en.title: Turin launches 'super fighter' project. Two thousand jobs coming
en.summary: Edgewing, a joint venture between Leonardo, BAE Systems, and Jaiec, is opening its first development and design facility in Turin, with aircraft production planned for Caselle.

stories.title: Tecnologia e spinta estera per la Liuc del futuro

en.title: Technology and international push for Liuc's future
en.summary: Liuc university is integrating artificial intelligence into its programs while expanding international engagement and strengthening connections with businesses through external partnerships.
